About SR Live FM Radio

SR Live FM Radio is an internet radio player published by SUN RATHNA. It helps listeners discover and play radio stations that provide online audio streams, including FM broadcasters that also stream over the internet and internet-only radio stations.

The app does not provide physical FM tuner reception and does not broadcast or own the radio stations listed. Availability, stream quality, programming, language and station branding are controlled by the respective station operators.

Listening requirement: An internet connection is required. A terrestrial FM station that does not provide an online stream cannot be played through this app.

Publisher: SUN RATHNA

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 18 November 2026

This Policy explains how information may be handled when you use SR Live FM Radio. The exact information processed depends on the app version, station-directory service and features you use.

1. Station discovery and playback

When you browse stations or play a stream, your device connects to station-directory services and/or the selected station's streaming servers. Those services may receive technical connection information such as your IP address, device and network information, request time and stream activity under their own privacy practices. Radio station operators may independently log requests to their streams.

2. Preferences stored on your device

Favourites, recently played stations, selected language and app preferences may be stored locally on your device. You can generally remove local app data by clearing the app's storage or uninstalling it, subject to device backups.

3. Accounts and personal information

The app is intended as a radio-listening utility and does not require a listener profile to play public radio streams. If a future version introduces sign-in, profiles or cloud synchronisation, this Policy and the Google Play Data safety declarations must be updated before release.

4. Advertising, analytics and diagnostics

AdMob is not currently integrated into the app, and this Policy does not state that the app currently displays AdMob advertisements. If AdMob or another advertising, analytics or crash-reporting SDK is added in a future release, we will update this Policy and the applicable Google Play Data safety declarations before publishing that release. Such providers may process device identifiers, app interactions, diagnostics or other information described in their own disclosures.

5. Sharing and service providers

Technical connection information may be processed by the station-directory provider, radio station or streaming host, and by other providers required for enabled app features. We do not sell personal information to data brokers. Information may also be disclosed where required by applicable law. Third-party services operate under their own privacy policies.

6. Retention and deletion

Station preferences stored locally can generally be cleared through app or device settings. If you contact support, we may retain the correspondence as needed to respond and maintain reasonable records. To request deletion of support correspondence or ask a privacy question, contact us.

7. Children

The app is a general radio player and is not designed to knowingly collect personal information from children. Parents or guardians should supervise children's use of internet-connected services.

8. Security and policy changes

We take reasonable steps to protect information under our control, but no internet transmission can be guaranteed completely secure. We may update this Policy when app functionality or integrations change.
